title: Ridgeline Project Loan Financing and the Installation Start-of-Work Payment
content:
A Ridgeline Installation Services customer whose project is financed by an open Ridgeline Project Loan, a Ridgeline Consumer Credit installment account, pays a reduced financing share of the progress share due at the start of work.

**Clause.** Financing share of the start-of-work payment: the customer's active Ridgeline Consumer Credit account that carries a draw period end date is their Project Loan; when its draw period end date is after today and its approved amount is at least the contract price billed, the full-loan share of 0.5 applies; when its draw period end date is after today and its approved amount is below the contract price billed, the partial-loan share of 0.75 applies; with no such open Project Loan the financing share is 1.

The progress share, the program's progress payment percentage of the contract price billed, is multiplied by the financing share before it is rounded to the cent; the share itself is never rounded.

## Records that decide the share

The customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit accounts: the Ridgeline Project Loan 66, 78 or 84 account, its status (only an active account counts), its draw period end date, and its approved amount (the credit line of the loan). An account that carries no draw period end date is not a Project Loan.

| Active Project Loan | Draw period end date | Approved amount compared with the contract price billed | Financing share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | after today | at least equal | 0.5 |
| yes | after today | below | 0.75 |
| yes | today or earlier | any | 1 |
| no | none | none | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical contract price billed 12000.00, progress payment percentage 25)

| Project Loan (hypothetical) | Share | Progress share |
|---|---|---|
| active, draw period ends next month, approved 15000.00 | 0.5 | 1500.00 |
| active, draw period ends next month, approved 8000.00 | 0.75 | 2250.00 |
| active, draw period ended yesterday | 1 | 3000.00 |
